A wonderful stay!
Jun 2026 • Family
An exceptional stay in Hanoi’s Old Quarter! The staff were incredibly attentive, friendly, and professional throughout my visit. The hotel’s Indochine inspired design is stunning, with elegant details and a unique, luxurious atmosphere. I also appreciated their commitment to sustainability and eco friendly practices. Highly recommended for anyone looking for comfort, style, and outstanding hospitality in Hanoi.

Excellent service and advice
Dec 2025 • Couples
I stayed the night in the La Mejor Indochine Hotel and enjoyed the breakfast in the morning. The food was excellent and the staff were so friendly and accommodating. They provided advice on which authentic foods to eat. The restaurant manager, Huy, was the best part of the experience for us. He was not only our waiter, but he provided recommendations on places in Hanoi that we should see and where to go for the best food. He went above and beyond expectations. Our experience was so good, we decided to book another night at this hotel instead of trying somewhere new.
